deadline.value: Materials for regular fall admission must be received by January 15.
deadline.quote: For regular Fall admission, application materials must be received by January 15th

gre_general.value: The Department of Biology does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Biology does not require GRE scores

gre_subject.value: The department does not require GRE scores, so no subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: The Department of Biology does not require GRE scores

supervisor.value: Applicants must name a faculty advisor who has agreed to take them; rotation applicants need approval from at least three faculty.
supervisor.quote: Applicants identify in the statement of research interests the name of the faculty advisor who has agreed to accept them in the lab

also.quote: Applicants to the rotating program contact potential faculty before applying and gain approval from at least three faculty for their rotation

funding.value: PhD applicants are admitted only if there is evidence of financial support, usually a departmental assistantship.
funding.quote: Applicants are only admitted to the PhD and thesis Master’s programs if there is evidence of financial support for their graduate studies

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Two entry routes: a named Major Advisor, or a three-lab rotation with no initial advisor.
